options.name: api_port
options.description: Port for the Technitium DNS API. Defaults to 5380

options.name: api_token
options.description: API token for authenticating with the Technitium DNS API

options.name: api_url
options.description: Base URL for the Technitium DNS API

options.name: catalog
options.description: The name of the catalog zone to become its member zone.

options.name: dnssecValidation
options.description: Enable DNSSEC validation (Forwarder only)

options.name: forwarder
options.description: Address of DNS server to use as forwarder (Forwarder only)

options.name: initializeForwarder
options.description: Initialize Conditional Forwarder zone with FWD record (Forwarder only)

options.name: node
options.description: The node domain name for which this API call is intended When unspecified, the current node is used This parameter can be used only when Clustering is initialized

options.name: primaryNameServerAddresses
options.description: List of primary name server IP addresses or names (Secondary, SecondaryForwarder, SecondaryCatalog, Stub)

options.name: protocol
options.description: DNS transport protocol for Conditional Forwarder zone.

options.name: proxyAddress
options.description: Proxy server address (Forwarder only)

options.name: proxyPassword
options.description: Proxy server password (Forwarder only)

options.name: proxyPort
options.description: Proxy server port (Forwarder only)

options.name: proxyType
options.description: Proxy type for conditional forwarding (Forwarder only)

options.name: proxyUsername
options.description: Proxy server username (Forwarder only)

options.name: tsigKeyName
options.description: TSIG key name (Secondary, SecondaryForwarder, SecondaryCatalog)

options.name: type
options.description: The type of zone to be created.

options.name: useSoaSerialDateScheme
options.description: Enable using date scheme for SOA serial (Primary, Forwarder, Catalog zones)

options.name: validateZone
options.description: Enable ZONEMD validation (Secondary only)

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when making API requests

options.name: zone
options.description: The domain name for creating the new zone

options.name: zoneTransferProtocol
options.description: Zone transfer protocol (Secondary, SecondaryForwarder, SecondaryCatalog)
